component.name: Wisp
component.summary: EverQuest log parser and in-game overlay for Linux and Steam Deck

description.p: A light over the fight. Wisp reads the log EverQuest Legends already writes and turns it into a small in-game overlay: kill counts, spell timers, and a live encounter meter for damage and healing.

Three small binaries do the work: wispd tails the log headlessly, wisp is the command-line launcher and diagnostic tool, and wisp-hud draws the overlay by asking the compositor for a window on top, never by touching the game's process or memory. Nothing is injected and no game data ships with it.
